Description: Galaxy MCP resource server on ECS Express Mode. Requires an existing production OAuth broker; does not create one or configure a custom domain.

ServiceName.Description: Unique service name in the default ECS cluster. Changing it replaces the service.

ImageUri.Description: Reviewed linux/amd64 image in ECR, pinned by sha256 digest, not a mutable tag.

ExecutionRoleArn.Description: Existing ECS task execution role: image pull, logs, and read access to only the specified secret (plus its KMS key if needed).

InfrastructureRoleArn.Description: Existing infrastructure role with the ECS Express Gateway Services trust and permissions.

PublicSubnetA.Description: Approved PUBLIC subnet with an Internet Gateway route and at least 8 free IPs.

PublicSubnetB.Description: Approved PUBLIC subnet in the same VPC but a DIFFERENT availability zone; at least 8 free IPs.

PublicBaseUrl.Description: Owned HTTPS origin, without trailing slash or path. Configure this hostname on the ALB listener, certificate, and DNS separately.

OAuthMetadataUrl.Description: Existing broker discovery URL. Must advertise PKCE S256, galaxy:full, and client_secret_basic introspection.

IntrospectionClientId.Description: Dedicated confidential resource-server client authorized to obtain Galaxy credentials through introspection.

IntrospectionSecretArn.Description: Full ARN of an existing Secrets Manager secret in this Region. Entire SecretString must be the nonempty client secret, not JSON. Never enter the secret itself here.

GalaxyInstancesJson.Description: Nonempty JSON map of approved instance names to HTTPS Galaxy URLs, without credentials. Validated by the service at startup.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Select two distinct public subnets; also verify they belong to different availability zones in the same VPC.

PublicMcpUrl.Description: Usable only after the custom hostname has a valid ALB certificate, listener rule, and DNS record.

ManagedEndpoint.Description: AWS-assigned endpoint. Health checks work here; MCP rejects this Host when PublicBaseUrl is a different hostname.
